Intel CFO at Deutsche Bank Technology Conference, 2026-Aug-26
. 18A yields are progressing, beating the milestones that we've internally set
. 14A, when you look at the defect density is tracking better than the target curve we had
. can expect us to land in October with that 0.9 PDK (of 14A)
. we're now seeing demand from our internal customers on 14A
. Lip-Bu and the team are now meeting on a weekly basis with (external) customers (on 14A)
. We feel very confident around how we're performing in terms of advanced packaging, in particular, EMIB-T
. it (EMIB-T) will be multiple billion dollars per customer per year of business.. ramp in the back half of 2027, a run rate business in 2028, hitting its stride in 2029
. he (Lip-Bu Tan) collapsed the number of layers of the organization.. from 12 down to 6.. eliminated VPs from 450 to maybe 200
. (Intel Foundry) running at like a $2.5 billion loss or so per quarter
